dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss is quite fond of this game, too. When he first started playing, he'd look for people to duel every day, boasting about his skills all the while. But then he got around to playing a few rounds with me... Don't think he's been nearly as cocky since.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Take care. I'll be heading out soon, too. Hmm... now what kinds of souvenirs should I get before I leave?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: This kind of game isn't that hard to play once you figure out the fundamental logic behind it.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You know what they say — practice makes perfect. I think I'll need to find some more time to practice my decks.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll play. I've dabbled a bit in this kind of game before, so I know a trick or two.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Hmm... if there were official tournaments or organizations for this game, then I suppose I could try my hand at becoming a certified TCG player.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Seems like I've still got a ways to go before mastering this game.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: No problem. I've played quite a few matches with other members of the Arataki Gang, but none of them are any good... Let's see how good you are.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...Don't mention a word of this to Boss. The moment he finds out, he'll proclaim me the "Genius Invokation TCG Champion of the Arataki Gang," and drag me off to all sorts of places to play on his behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Not bad at all. Got any interest in becoming Boss' TCG coach? Just the other day, he swore that he'd put some serious effort into getting better at the game.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
